note.question: When can a digital-content manufacturer and a distribution platform jointly fight piracy through quality and enforcement, when does a wholesale contract outperform an agency contract for each party and for the channel?
note.overview: The article compares two explicit multistage manufacturer–platform games under piracy.

methodEvidence.section: Distribution Contracts, Costs, and Profit Functions

sources.quote: We model a distribution channel consisting of an upstream content creator or manufacturer (henceforth, referred to as the manufacturer or M), who develops a digital product or content, such as an e-book, music, video, software, or a game, and a downstream platform or retailer (henceforth, referred to as the retailer or P), such as Amazon, Apple, Google, Netflix, or Microsoft, who intermediates product sales to end consumers.
